Help the shelter

Give what you can.

Food, clothing, time or a financial contribution: speak to HUP about the most useful way for you to help.

Donate moneyDonate itemsPlan a donationVolunteer
MONEY

Make a donation

Contact HUP for its banking details and the reference to use. Confirm the account directly with the team before making a payment.

Let the team know if you need an acknowledgement for your records. Ask about receipt arrangements before donating.

Request banking details
FOOD & CLOTHING

Give useful items

Food and clothing donations have supported HUP’s work. Check what is needed now, how much the shelter can accept and when to deliver.

Please arrange the drop-off address and time before bringing your donation.

Arrange a drop-off
TIME & SKILLS

Lend a hand

Tell HUP what you or your organisation can offer, how many people would like to help and when you are available.

The team can discuss suitable tasks and arrange your visit in advance.

Ask about volunteering

START WITH WHAT’S NEEDED

Make your donation count.

A quick call helps you give something the shelter can use. These are things to discuss with HUP, rather than a confirmed list of today’s shortages.

Food

Tell the team what you can supply, the quantity and any expiry dates. Check storage and delivery arrangements, especially for fresh or prepared food.

Clothing

Describe the sizes and types of clothing you would like to donate. Ask what is needed and bring clean items in usable condition.

Personal care

If you would like to give soap, toothpaste or other toiletries, ask which items and quantities the shelter can accept before buying.

Practical help

Offer your skills or your team’s time. Ask about suitable tasks, supervision and any materials that would need to be arranged.

Ask what is needed now

LET’S ARRANGE IT

Plan your donation.

Choose what you would like to offer and add a few details. We’ll put them into an enquiry for you to review.

This does not make a payment or book a drop-off. HUP will need to confirm the arrangements.

I would like to offer

Bring your team along.

A workplace, community group or group of friends can start by telling HUP what they have in mind.

  1. Tell us your idea

    Include your group size, skills and possible dates. Ask the shelter what would be most useful.

  2. Agree on the plan

    Confirm the activity, materials, location and who will meet your group. Please arrange photographs with HUP beforehand.

  3. Keep in touch

    If you would like to help regularly, ask about a suitable ongoing arrangement.
